title: 環境工学Ⅰ
subtitle: Environmental Engineering I
keywords: History of environment issue 2.Development and environment 3.Development and environment 4.Example of investigation 5.Example of measures
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn how to think, investigate and evaluate environmental consideration in development work, referring to case. (2) acquire knowledge to solve environmental issue. This course relates to regional alliances.
advice: This is a basic skills course for environmental engineering. We will cover the following materials: 1. Background about pollution, Environment issue in construction project 2. System of law about environmental assessment, Environmental factor of development work, Setting of environmental item 3. Method of investigation and prediction for pollution, Its evaluation and measures methods 4. Method of investigation and prediction for bio, Its evaluation and measures methods
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of law and standard concerning environment

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
